description: Source code for the SqlPropertyValueStore class, implementing storage operations for property values in a Mattermost server, including create, read, update, delete, search, and upsert functionalities.

classes.name: SqlPropertyValueStore
classes.description: A struct implementing storage operations for property values, including methods for create, retrieve, update, delete, search, and upsert.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new property value record in the database.

methods.name: CreateMany
methods.description: Creates multiple property value records in a transaction.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by group ID and ID.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves multiple property values by IDs and optional group ID.

methods.name: SearchPropertyValues
methods.description: Searches for property values based on various search options.

methods.name: Upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates property values with conflict handling.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks a property value as deleted by setting DeleteAt.

methods.name: DeleteForField
methods.description: Marks property values for a specific field as deleted.

methods.name: DeleteForTarget
methods.description: Deletes property values for a specific target type and ID.
